outcome_def: HRM mutation scanning vs Sanger resequencing of the same 47 TP53 DNAs. Counts are POOLED over the amplicons of each group; the paper prints no per-amplicon contingency table, so no per-amplicon outcome exists here. These are mutation-scanning calls (variant present / no variant), not allele-specific primer discrimination and not a genotype cluster call.
calibration: uncalibrated: the 400 bp grouping is the authors' cut point, not a threshold we fitted or endorse
